summary: Prologis L.P. via Prologis Yen Finance LLC priced a ¥44.0B multi-tranche yen-denominated note offering on June 4, 2026, expected to close June 11, 2026. The notes comprise ¥32.6B 2.527% notes due 2030, ¥3.5B 3.389% notes due 2035, and ¥8.9B 3.905% notes due 2041. This is a routine debt financing creating a direct financial obligation, not a special situation; no change of control, tender offer, or restructuring is involved. The filing reports the incurrence of debt under Item 2.03 and the pricing under Item 8.01 as a capital markets transaction.
